20
# Guards no production path reaches.
#
# Every `pub fn` named check/verify/validate/require/enforce/assert/reject/
# refuse/deny/guard is a refusal by its own naming. Twenty of them are
# reachable only from tests, which means they protect the tests.
#
# The number may only go down. Wiring one up, or moving it into a module that
# honestly declares `WIRING: unwired`, lowers it; lower this file in the same
# pull request or the gain is given back silently.
#
# Not a hard zero on purpose: twenty modules cannot be wired in one reviewable
# change, and a gate that demands that gets switched off. A number that can
# only fall gets paid down.
#
# The twenty, at the time this baseline was set:
#
#   src/ai/execution/verify.rs              verify_execution_proof_full
#   src/ai/execution/verify.rs              verify_execution_proof_structural
#   src/budlumxyz/mod.rs                    verify_app
#   src/chain/snapshot.rs                   verify_authentic
#   src/consensus/qc.rs                     verify_against_blob
#   src/consensus/qc.rs                     verify_against_snapshot
#   src/core/block.rs                       verify_signature_with_pubkey
#   src/cross_domain/evm/adapter.rs         verify_deposit
#   src/cross_domain/evm/sync_committee.rs  verify_sync_aggregate
#   src/crypto/primitives.rs                validate_public_key (x3)
#   src/domain/finality_adapter.rs          verify_finality_with_claim
#   src/domain/storage_deal.rs              verify_answer_challenge_zk_proof
#   src/domain/storage_deal.rs              verify_coding_audit
#   src/execution/proof_verifier.rs         validate_envelope_structure
#   src/lubot/mod.rs                        validate_inference_grant
#   src/lubot/verify.rs                     verify_inference_stark
#   src/settlement/proof_market.rs          enforce_max_sizes
#   src/settlement/proof_verifier.rs        verify_event_from_registry
